title: seo: publish the MCP server to the official MCP registry
problem: Agents increasingly find tools through MCP registries. The repo builds an MCP server package and generates a server.json for registry.modelcontextprotocol.io, but publishing needs a GitHub login proving the io.github.<owner> namespace, so no agent has run it.
evidence: portfolio/distribution/channels.yaml, channel mcp-server: owner_ask 'same npm token as npm-cli-packages; set DISTRIBUTE_MCP=true; optionally run mcp-publisher once against the generated server.json'
change: Owner: set the repository variable DISTRIBUTE_MCP=true with the npm token (the existing ask), then run mcp-publisher once logged in as the account against the generated server.json. Listing in third-party directories under the portfolio's name waits on the publication-identity decision.
metric: registry entry exists for the server
source: Owner asked for SEO and AI-search action items in a Claude Code session, 2026-10-24
